findings.summary: Gannet achieves higher success rates than Ledger-RNN on unseen layouts from all three training map families (Warehouse, Office, Cavern), with differences of 7.2, 5.5, and 6.8 percentage points respectively.
findings.scope: Unseen layouts from training families (Warehouse, Office, Cavern), success rate metric, mean over 5 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: Gannet also achieves higher success rates than Ledger-RNN on all three held-out map families (Orchard, Harbor, Quarry), with differences of 11.3, 8.8, and 9.8 percentage points respectively.
findings.scope: Held-out map families (Orchard, Harbor, Quarry), success rate metric, mean over 5 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: Gannet also produces shorter mean episode lengths on successful episodes than Ledger-RNN across all six evaluated conditions (three training families and three held-out families), with differences ranging from 12 to 21 steps.
findings.scope: All six evaluated conditions (unseen training-family layouts and held-out families), mean episode length of successful episodes, mean over 5 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

sentences.text: Gannet achieved higher success rates than Ledger-RNN on unseen layouts from all three training map families (Warehouse: 88.4% vs 81.2%; Office: 85.1% vs 79.6%; Cavern: 79.3% vs 72.5%).

This advantage also held on all three held-out map families (Orchard: 71.6% vs 60.3%; Harbor: 68.2% vs 59.4%; Quarry: 64.9% vs 55.1%), indicating that Gannet's benefit generalizes beyond the map families used in training.
Gannet also produced shorter mean episode lengths on successful episodes than Ledger-RNN across all six conditions, with differences ranging from 12 to 21 steps.
However, no statistical tests were reported, so these differences are descriptive only.
